prompt: A fresh 16-byte pipe. What does each call return?

trace.label: [r1] read from the empty, open pipe

explain: An empty pipe whose writer is still open says "try again" with -1. The 20-byte write is short: only 16 bytes fit. Reading 10 leaves 6 buffered. Closing the writer does not discard them, so the next read returns those 6; only after that is the pipe empty and closed, which is end of file (0).
